d.title: Dragon Ball Super: Ginga Patrol
d.en: Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol
d.jp: ドラゴンボール超 銀河パトロール
d.synopsis: The main character, Son Goku, and Vegeta, work together with the members of the Galactic Patrol, the peacekeepers of the galaxy, to begin a super scale battle against a new enemy, "Planet-Eater" Moro!
